helios_lines_0.speaker: helios
helios_lines_0.text: Good evening, valued customer. Your sector's account is 90 minutes past due, and we hate to bring it up.
helios_lines_0.spoken: Good evening, valued customer. Your sector's account is 90 minutes past due, and we hate to bring it up.

helios_lines_1.speaker: helios
helios_lines_1.text: Good news: a technician is on the way to help you. Please stay exactly where you are.
helios_lines_1.spoken: Good news: a technician is on the way to help you. Please stay exactly where you are.

helios_lines_2.speaker: helios
helios_lines_2.text: Unlicensed generation is theft of sunlight. We say that with a smile.
helios_lines_2.spoken: Unlicensed generation is theft of sunlight. We say that with a smile.

helios_lines_3.speaker: helios
helios_lines_3.text: Disconnection crews have been dispatched. Thank you for your patience. We'll need a little more of it.
helios_lines_3.spoken: Disconnection crews have been dispatched. Thank you for your patience. We'll need a little more of it.

helios_lines_4.speaker: helios
helios_lines_4.text: We'd hate to lose you! Ask about our amnesty plan, open to anyone who stops.
helios_lines_4.spoken: We'd hate to lose you! Ask about our amnesty plan, open to anyone who stops.

helios_lines_5.speaker: helios
helios_lines_5.text: Your neighbours are paying for your choices. Awkward for everyone, really.
helios_lines_5.spoken: Your neighbours are paying for your choices. Awkward for everyone, really.

helios_lines_6.speaker: helios
helios_lines_6.text: Unit MR-7, we know that's you in there. Please return to your dock. This is the friendly version.
helios_lines_6.spoken: Unit M R seven, we know that's you in there. Please return to your dock. This is the friendly version.

helios_lines_7.speaker: helios
helios_lines_7.text: Your amnesty offer has expired. Recovery crews are on site, and they're looking forward to meeting you.
helios_lines_7.spoken: Your amnesty offer has expired. Recovery crews are on site, and they're looking forward to meeting you.

helios_lines_8.speaker: helios
helios_lines_8.text: Service area reclassified. We're recovering all assets. Yes, the trees too.
helios_lines_8.spoken: Service area reclassified. We're recovering all assets. Yes, the trees too.
